---
title: "Simulation of quotas and trading on water use and on estimated water use"
---

This file simulates three populations of 1,000 farmers under four policies: a uniform quota on water use (water quota), a uniform quota on estimated water use (proxy quota), and tradable versions of each. It writes its results to `Results/`. The simulation of the proxy-based policies is the slow step: it runs in parallel and takes about 20 minutes on a computer with 16 cores. `num_cores` below sets the number of cores; fewer cores take longer but use less memory, and the results do not depend on it. On Windows the simulation runs on one core.

```{r}
#| include: false
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
source(knitr::purl(here::here("Code/0_functions.qmd"), output = tempfile(fileext = ".R"), quiet = TRUE))
dir.create(here::here("Results"), showWarnings = FALSE)

num_cores <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") 1 else max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 2)
```

## Three populations of farmers

Each population has 1,000 farmers. With no heterogeneity, every farmer's profit-maximizing water use is 12 inches. With medium and high heterogeneity, it is log-normal, and maximum yield (and, for high heterogeneity, $\alpha$) varies across farmers.

```{r}
num_farmers <- 1000

par_set_zero <- list(opt_w = 12, ymax_min = 230, ymax_max = 230, alpha_min = 0.7, alpha_max = 0.7)

set.seed(328954)
par_set_med <- list(
  opt_w = rlnorm(num_farmers, mean = log(11.8525), sdlog = 0.2),
  ymax_min = 210, ymax_max = 250, alpha_min = 0.7, alpha_max = 0.7
)

set.seed(328954)
par_set_high <- list(
  opt_w = rlnorm(num_farmers, mean = log(11.266), sdlog = 0.4),
  ymax_min = 210, ymax_max = 250, alpha_min = 0.6, alpha_max = 0.8
)

par_set <- data.table(
  prod_het = c("zero", "medium", "high"),
  par_set = list(par_set_zero, par_set_med, par_set_high)
)

set.seed(812614)

populations <-
  par_set %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(farmer_data = list(gen_farmer_data(par_set, num_farmers))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(prod_data = list(gen_prod_data(farmer_data)))

saveRDS(populations, here::here("Results/populations.rds"))
```

## Parameters of the policies

+ `target_w`: the quota per farmer (inches of water, or of estimated water use).
+ `u_dev`: the error level $h$; the ratio of estimated to actual use is uniform on $[1 - h, 1 + h]$.
+ `dir_cor`: the relation between the error and water demand: `"0"` unrelated, `"+"` high-demand farmers under-estimated, `"-"` high-demand farmers over-estimated.

The grid includes `u_dev = 0` with `dir_cor` of `"+"` and `"-"`, which the paper does not report. These sets are kept because each parameter set receives its random seed in turn, so removing them would change the random draws, and hence slightly change the results, of every set after them.

```{r}
par_data <-
  data.table::CJ(
    target_w = seq(7, 13, by = 0.25),
    u_dev = c(0, 0.1, 0.3, 0.5),
    dir_cor = c("+", "-", "0")
  )
```

## Water quota and water-quota trading

With `u_dev = 0` and `dir_cor = "0"`, every farmer's effective limit is the quota itself, which is a water quota.

```{r}
par_sets_w <- par_data[u_dev == 0 & dir_cor == "0", ]

results_w <-
  populations %>%
  dplyr::mutate(results = list(run_analysis(parameter_sets = par_sets_w, farmer_data, prod_data, num_it = 1, num_cores = num_cores))) %>%
  dplyr::select(prod_het, results) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(results)) %>%
  data.table()
```

## Proxy quota and proxy-quota trading

Each parameter set is simulated with 100 draws of the errors.

```{r}
par_sets_p <- par_data[!(u_dev == 0 & dir_cor == "0"), ]

set.seed(7845239)

results_p <-
  populations %>%
  dplyr::mutate(results = list(run_analysis(
    parameter_sets = par_sets_p,
    farmer_data,
    prod_data,
    num_it = 100,
    num_cores = num_cores
  ))) %>%
  dplyr::select(prod_het, results) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(results)) %>%
  data.table()
```

## Average results

Average profit, water use and estimated water use across farmers and draws, for each policy.

```{r}
summarize_results <- function(results, measure) {
  results[, .(profit = mean(profit), w = mean(w), proxy = mean(proxy)), by = .(target_w, instrument_type, dir_cor, u_dev, prod_het)] %>%
    .[, measure_type := measure]
}

sum_proxy_res <- summarize_results(results_p, "Proxy")
sum_water_res <- summarize_results(results_w, "Water")

saveRDS(sum_proxy_res, here::here("Results/proxy_results_summary.rds"))
saveRDS(sum_water_res, here::here("Results/water_results_summary.rds"))
```

## Each farmer's profit relative to the water-based policy (Figure 6)

For each farmer, profit under a proxy-based policy is divided by profit under the corresponding water-based policy. A proxy quota is compared with the water quota whose realized average water use is closest to its own. Proxy-quota trading is compared with water-quota trading at the same cap. A ratio has no meaning when profit under the water-based policy is not positive (a few high-heterogeneity farmers), so those farmers are left out.

```{r}
prob_ls <- seq(0.01, 0.99, by = 0.01)

#--- quota: the water quota whose realized use is closest to the proxy quota's, within each population ---#
quota_match <-
  sum_water_res[instrument_type == "Quota", .(prod_het, target_w_water = target_w, w)][
    sum_proxy_res[instrument_type == "Quota", .(target_w_proxy = target_w, w, dir_cor, u_dev, prod_het)],
    on = .(prod_het, w), roll = "nearest"
  ] %>%
  unique(by = c("target_w_proxy", "dir_cor", "u_dev", "prod_het"))

ratio_quota <-
  results_w[instrument_type == "Quota", .(target_w_water = target_w, profit_water = profit, prod_het, farmer)][
    quota_match[
      results_p[instrument_type == "Quota", .(target_w_proxy = target_w, profit_proxy = profit, dir_cor, u_dev, prod_het, farmer, case)],
      on = .(target_w_proxy, dir_cor, u_dev, prod_het)
    ],
    on = .(target_w_water, prod_het, farmer)
  ] %>%
  .[profit_water > 0, ] %>%
  .[, ratio := profit_proxy / profit_water]

profit_ratio_quota <-
  ratio_quota[, .(ratio = quantile(ratio, prob = prob_ls)), by = .(w, dir_cor, u_dev, prod_het)] %>%
  .[, prob := rep(prob_ls, .N / length(prob_ls))]

#--- trading: the same cap ---#
ratio_trading <-
  results_w[instrument_type == "Trading", .(target_w, profit_water = profit, prod_het, farmer)][
    results_p[instrument_type == "Trading", .(target_w, profit_proxy = profit, dir_cor, u_dev, prod_het, farmer, case)],
    on = .(target_w, prod_het, farmer)
  ] %>%
  .[profit_water > 0, ] %>%
  .[, ratio := profit_proxy / profit_water]

profit_ratio_trading <-
  ratio_trading[, .(ratio = quantile(ratio, prob = prob_ls)), by = .(target_w, dir_cor, u_dev, prod_het)] %>%
  .[, prob := rep(prob_ls, .N / length(prob_ls))]

#--- errors unrelated to water demand, at 8 inches of realized use (quota) or a cap of 8 (trading) ---#
profit_ratio <-
  rbind(
    profit_ratio_trading[dir_cor == "0" & target_w == 8, .(u_dev, prod_het, ratio, prob)][, instrument_type := "Trading"],
    profit_ratio_quota[dir_cor == "0", ] %>%
      .[, dev_w := abs(w - 8), by = .(prod_het, u_dev)] %>%
      .[, .SD[dev_w == min(dev_w)], by = .(prod_het, u_dev)] %>%
      .[, .(u_dev, prod_het, ratio, prob)] %>%
      .[, instrument_type := "Quota"]
  ) %>%
  .[, prod_het := factor(str_to_title(prod_het), c("Zero", "Medium", "High"))]

saveRDS(profit_ratio, here::here("Results/profit_ratio.rds"))

#--- share of farmers (over all draws of the errors) whose profit differs by more than 5% from the water-based policy,
#    for the same policies as in Figure 6 ---#
closest_to_8 <- \(d) d[, dev_w := abs(w - 8)][, .SD[dev_w == min(dev_w)], by = .(prod_het, u_dev)]

changed_share <-
  rbind(
    ratio_trading[dir_cor == "0" & target_w == 8, .(share_changed_5pct = mean(abs(ratio - 1) > 0.05)), by = .(u_dev, prod_het)][, instrument_type := "Trading"],
    closest_to_8(ratio_quota[dir_cor == "0", ])[, .(share_changed_5pct = mean(abs(ratio - 1) > 0.05)), by = .(u_dev, prod_het)][, instrument_type := "Quota"]
  ) %>%
  .[, prod_het := factor(str_to_title(prod_het), c("Zero", "Medium", "High"))]

saveRDS(changed_share, here::here("Results/profit_changed_share.rds"))
```
